subject: ACTION: Push finals-diagnostic-2 to MCM site — Kai takes it today
body:
FA — finals-diagnostic-2.json is committed and ready at C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\finals-diagnostic-2.json (commit aa765ad). It is already in manifest.json. Please push kai-algebra2-tests to the live MCM site so Kai can access the exam today. This is time-sensitive — Kai's final is Tuesday and this is the last full practice run.

The exam is 15 questions, all W1-W6 standards, harder than D1. Kai scored 14/15 on D1 (93%). D2 fills the gaps: abs value parent (Q3), vertex+point form (Q11), AC factoring a!=1 (Q12), negative fractional exponents (Q2, Q7), two-step radical isolation (Q5-Q6), required radical simplification in quad formula (Q15).

Also flagging: the Send to Dad button on D1 did not work — please investigate before D2 goes live. The results were not transmitted.
